artboards.title: 1 · Bring in a skill library: ECC
2 · Each role, its worker and its skills
3 · A manager hands work to a worker

annotations.text: Decisions in this design: every business role can hand work to a worker, not only engineering. A worker is Claude Code, briefed as the role, given only that role's skills, working in one folder (a vault folder for drafts, a branch of its own for code). Skills come from DevDeck's library, read from GitHub and added by you; hooks, MCP configs and install scripts never come in; ~/.claude is left alone.

The approval is per session, as the turn decided: the handoff card says what it may and will not do, where, and its time and money limit. A standing yes is per role, per kind of work, per place. Nothing ever sends, posts, pays, pushes or merges. A missing CLI blocks, it never silently skips.
Open: add a Design role to the catalogue? Codex as a second worker? Should a kept draft be copied into knowledge whole, or only a line pointing at it? Per-role budgets, or one for the business?
